{{nihongo|'''Ōarahiko Shrine, Tomoyui Shrine'''|大荒比古神社・鞆結神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Ōmi Province]].

'''Ōarahiko Shrine / Tomoyui Shrine''' (おおあらひこじんじゃ・ともゆいじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} complex in Ura, Makino-chō, {{ill|Takashima, Shiga|Q845794|qid=Q845794}}, {{ill|Shiga Prefecture|Q131358|qid=Q131358}}. Two shrines are jointly enshrined in one listing, and both are treated as candidate shrines for {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}. Former shrine rank: {{ill|Gō-sha|Q134917316|qid=Q134917316}}.

=== Shrine crest ===
Kuwagata

=== History ===
According to shrine tradition, it was founded in the reign of {{ill|Emperor Chūai|Q179971|qid=Q179971}}, and later revered as the {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=sōsha}} of Tomoyui-go (Tomoyui-shō). Both Tomoyui Shrine and Ōarahiko Shrine are identified as Shikinaisha, and both have other candidate shrines.

In {{ill|1876|Q7766|qid=Q7766}} (Meiji 9), it was ranked as gōsha.
